versions.content: If KeyMCryptoKeyStartFinalizeFunctionEnabled is set to TRUE, this function will conclude the key update operation. All keys that have flagged to be updated during the session shall be finalized by calling Csm_KeySetValid(). The validation shall be done for all keys that have been updated, even if Csm_KeySet Valid() returns a failure for one of the keys. This is to finalize as much keys as possible even if one key fails. If at least one key fails, then the overall result is a fail information in the callback result.
